title: Dole Institute of Politics announces summer America at 250 programming
summary_en: The Robert J. Dole Institute of Politics at the University of Kansas announced today its summer programming lineup in honor of the 250th anniversary of the signing of the U.S. Declaration of Independence on July 4. All events are free and open to the public.
title_cn: Dole Institute of Politics announces summer America at 250 programming

title: KU Law earns third consecutive national transactional law title
summary_en: A team from the University of Kansas School of Law extended KU Law’s winning streak this spring, earning top honors for the third consecutive year at the Wayne State Taft Transactional Law Invitational. Third-year law student Kaegan Cowan and second-year law student Emily Weiss brought home one of the competition’s top prizes — best draft.
title_cn: KU Law earns third consecutive national transactional law title

title: KU-led ‘Wall of Wind’ research ongoing; findings tie in to tornado season
summary_en: Elaina Sutley, Diane M. Darvin Chair’s Council Associate Professor of Civil, Environmental & Architectural Engineering at the University of Kansas, is leading the research, which aims to make it plain to federal regulators why the nationwide building code for manufactured homes needs an update.
title_cn: KU-led ‘Wall of Wind’ research ongoing; findings tie in to tornado season

title: Study shows comprehension intervention, working memory predict math achievement in English learners
summary_en: University of Kansas professor Michael Orosco led a study that found an intervention designed to improve students' reading comprehension boosted math achievement. Additionally, his research tied strong working memory to word problem-solving abilities.
title_cn: Study shows comprehension intervention, working memory predict math achievement in English learners

title: Ryan Bodensteiner announced as new director of the Center for Evaluation and Educational Leadership
summary_en: The Achievement & Assessment Institute (AAI) at the University of Kansas has announced Ryan Bodensteiner the director of the Center for Evaluation and Educational Leadership (CEEL), a center within AAI that supports district and building level leaders in creating and sustaining effective learning environments for students.
title_cn: Ryan Bodensteiner announced as new director of the Center for Evaluation and Educational Leadership

title: KU Kudos: Faculty and staff achievements, May 2026
summary_en: It’s time to celebrate Jayhawk colleagues’ achievements: KU News Service accepted submissions and combed websites, social media and newsletters for recent external honors and awards for current faculty and staff at the Lawrence, Edwards and Medical Center campuses and affiliates.
title_cn: KU Kudos: Faculty and staff achievements, May 2026

title: Engineering professor charts unexpected career path from thermodynamics to whiskey barrels
summary_en: Chris Depcik, University of Kansas professor of mechanical engineering, has created a solution to help distillers better predict how spirits mature inside a barrel.
title_cn: Engineering professor charts unexpected career path from thermodynamics to whiskey barrels
